LESSON: PLANT GROWTH AND DEVELOPMENT

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: GENERAL SCIENCE
Strand: Life Science
Topic 1.6: Plant growth and development
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 10

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Plant growth and development, part of Life Science in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 GENERAL SCIENCE.

Key inquiry question: Why is the concept of growth in plants important?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Plant growth and development together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and collaboration: as the learner discusses and shares information gathered on differences between plant

growth and development.

● Self-efficacy: as the learner works on own practical activities to investigate epigeal and hypogeal germination.

● Learning to learn: as the learner reflects on the experiments investigating conditions necessary for germination.

Values:
● Respect: Learner discusses with peers the differences between primary and secondary growth in plants taking into account

other's opinion.

● Responsibility: Learner engages in assigned roles while working with others in the process of learning such as

investigating conditions necessary for germination.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Socio Economic and environmental issues - Cyber security: as the learner observes online security when searching for

information on growth and development of plants using digital devices with assistive technology.

Suggested Learning Resources:

• Print textbooks in appropriate font and colour,

• Braille textbooks,

• Digital devices with assistive technology such as screen readers and screen magnifiers

22

Key Skills:

● Describing the causes of seed dormancy in plants.

● Distinguishing between primary and secondary growth in plants.
